desc:
THIS GAME WILL NOT BE CRAZILY p2w no matter what

A silent outbreak has hit Manhattan. Can you contain it before the city falls?

Last Stand is a top-down zombie outbreak strategy game. Thousands of New Yorkers go about their day while the infected hide among them, until they turn.

Build quarantine walls and checkpoint gates, send recon drones to expose hidden carriers, and deploy medics to cure the infected. Evacuate survivors by ferry and helicopter, fortify streets with machine-gun nests, and call in strike teams or a full bombing run when the horde gets too big.

Watch out for Runners, Brutes, Screamers and Bloaters, and for the night, when zombies get faster.

5 difficulties, from Easy to Nightmare
A full map of Manhattan, from the Battery to Inwood
Earn Research Points every game for permanent upgrades
Unlock a second HQ strike team

Save the city or watch it fall.
